purpose: Document first-party municipal cadastral discovery, public viewer/API inspection, bounded anonymous request outcomes, safe field limits, and uncertainty for Cumaná.
assessment: The official Cumaná SIGAT site identifies SAMAT, the municipal tax authority of Municipio Sucre, and links an inmueble urbano registration procedure. Its public taxpayer application uses /api/v1 and OpenLayers, and the anonymous municipality endpoint confirms id 320 as Alcaldía Bolivariana de Sucre in Estado Sucre. Property-specific contributor resources returned HTTP 403. No anonymous parcel geometry, CRS, schema, or stable native parcel identity was obtained, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.
registryAssessment: A local municipal registry/procedure custodian is evidenced through the official SIGAT/SAMAT portal and its inmueble urbano registration workflow. This is local service evidence, not proof of an open parcel-map API or citywide cadastral coverage.
